coordinateSystem.pixels: top-left origin; x right, y down
coordinateSystem.wallFacingMeaning: Wall facing is a surface, not floor rotation: front=neutral 0 degrees, left=left wall interior +45 degrees, right=right wall interior -45 degrees, relative to front-camera normal. Positive wall surface yaw points the normal toward screen right. Actual SceneKit modelYawDegrees=wallSurfaceYawDegrees-30.
coordinateSystem.world: x right, y up, z toward back wall

surfaceSemantics.entrySurface: top supporting surface at the named model-local cardinal rim; points receive the same mesh scale and facing as the image
surfaceSemantics.foodSurfaceCenter: full: top centre of the continuous food layer; empty: visible bowl interior centre
surfaceSemantics.seatCenter: top centre of the supporting cushion
